# Recoil research table (GENERATED by docs/tools/gen_recoil_pattern.py - do not edit)

Figures: **M** = measured (a trial, test, chronograph or manual figure, from recoil_measured.tsv), **S** = published spec (recoil_research.tsv), **E** = estimate. Impulse I and free-recoil energy E are DERIVED (I = m_b v + m_c 1.6 v; E = I^2 / 2M with the loaded magazine). kick1 / kick = the pattern's first-round and sustained climb in degrees (aimed, standing).
